**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Every other write to the run map happens under d.runs.mu. A later change that calls recoverRuns after the server starts would race.

## Files

- `internal/daemon/runs.go:164-232`: `recoverRuns`, including all five run-map assignment paths.
- `internal/daemon/runs_test.go:1553-1606`: `TestRecoverRunsWritesTheRunMapUnderTheLock`, alongside recovery tests.

## Failing tests

- `TestRecoverRunsWritesTheRunMapUnderTheLock`: under `go test -race`, read the run map under `d.runs.mu` while `recoverRuns` publishes registered queued, reconciled, failed-reconciliation, removed queued, and removed active runs. Each case must report a race before the fix and pass afterward. Remove each publication lock in turn and confirm its case reports a race.

## Implement

Take d.runs.mu around each write to d.runs.runs in the recoverRuns loop (internal/daemon/runs.go:180-227), not around Reconcile (:217; it can be slow). Write the race test first, watch it fail under -race, then add the lock. Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): take the lock. Nothing is open.
